mechanisms.c: map_err re-wraps the call result into a fresh Result local; the Err(e) store gives it a ptr-typed slice at +16, so SROA turns the copy from v3_buy_costs's out-param into one `load ptr` of +16 (plus `load i64` of +8) above the Ok/Err branch (Ok arm uses ptrtoint). The Err arm is then an empty edge to the shared Err return and the original layout follows (0x148330 mov64 r7,r4; 0x148338 ja +0x58). Without a re-wrap (plain ?, match-return, let-then-?, if-let) +16 is loaded as i64 in the Ok arm and as ptr in the Err arm, and the shared return block is placed right after the costs test.
mechanisms.a: With *const the callee param is `ptr nocapture noundef readonly %payer` (no noalias); with &AccountInfo it is `noalias nocapture noundef readonly align 8 dereferenceable(48)`. The only body difference in final IR is that, with noalias, GVN forwards the payer.key load made for create_associated_token_account_idempotent(&payer.key(),..) to payer.clone() after the call; without it the key is reloaded after the call, exactly as the original (0x154a8 ldxdw r1,[r9] before the call at 0x15578, 0x155b0 ldxdw r5,[r9] after). Every safe pointer-sized parameter carrying the AccountInfo address is noalias because AccountInfo is Freeze (checked with the identity rustc: Signer-like newtype by value, Option<&T>, ScalarPair all noalias; only raw pointers and &!Freeze pointees are not), and the non-noalias safe forms (&Signer, by-value clone, struct by reference) change the matched callers.
